summary.text: Jeffrey Solomon is a candidate with no party affiliation for Florida State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with incumbent Alexis Calatayud (R) and Democrat Richard Lamondin.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a chiropractor, inventor and small business owner who has served the South Florida community for more than 40 years.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey Solomon's career experience includes working as a doctor, and in a Ballotpedia survey he said he is a chiropractor who has taught future health care professionals.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 115 in 2018, when he lost to Vance Aloupis (R), 50.5 percent to 49.5 percent.

Solomon said in the survey that he is running as an independent and that his priorities include lowering property and health insurance costs, affordable health care, public education funding and teacher pay, transportation options to reduce traffic, housing affordability and government transparency.
